messages:
Ariane: Heads-up — product wants to start surfacing a deprecation banner for v1 API traffic next week. need plan for detection + opt-in backstop behavior.
Lee: Do we have a reliable signal to detect v1 callers? header, user-agent, or path?
Ariane: we currently accept both `Accept: application/vnd.redwood-v1+json` and legacy `X-API-Version: 1`. telemetry already tags those.
Matt: IMHO add a runtime header `X-RI-Compat: v1` from clients would be ideal, but we can’t expect user SDKs to ship immediately.
Jenny: For immediate detection we can use the existing UA pattern + Accept header. I'll add a rule in routing to tag and emit a metric.
Sam: Question: what should the routing policy be when we detect v1 traffic? automatic fallback to v1-shim? return 299 warning? fail fast?
Ariane: Product prefers a gentle nudge not a hard error — so warning header + console banner, but offer a backstop route for critical customers.
Lee: Warning header seems straightforward: `X-RI-Deprecated: v1;info=\"migrate to v2\"`. But browsers/clients will ignore it. We should also send an `event` to telemetry: `api.deprecation.v1_warning` with customer_id.
Matt: Also add an alpha flag so Dedicated/private customers can opt out of automatic fallback.
Jenny: I'll sketch the telemetry shape: increment `api.deprecation.v1_call_count` with tags `{region, model, customer_tier}` and a histogram for token latency.
Sam: How do we map quotas? If someone calls v1, do calls count against the v2 quota or maintain v1 quota?
Ariane: Product says keep billing consistent — map to the customer's active billing plan. But we need to avoid quota bypass.
Lee: Implementation: when we detect v1 headers, annotate request with `legacy_quota_bucket=<customer_id>:v1` and run through quota mapping service which resolves to the active plan. If ambiguity, default to stricter limit.
Matt: Caveat: routing fallback increases load on the v1 shim and may break SLOs. We should have a circuit breaker: if shim latency > 200ms p95 or error rate > 1%, stop fallback and return deprecation warning with 409.
Jenny: Agreed — add a dashboard tile and alert: `v1_shim_latency_p95` and `v1_shim_error_rate`. Put runbook for rollback.
Ariane: UX: console show live count of active v1 clients + top calling API keys, with CTA to generate migration report. Also a banner for customers in last 30 days.
Sam: For rollout: start experiment in `canary` region for 24h, capture telemetry, then enable global. Need a dry-run mode that emits instrumentation but doesn't change routing.
Matt: We'll need SDK changes: new header `X-RI-Compat` and a short-snippet in the JS/py SDKs. I'll coordinate with devex.
Lee: Ops: add an ingress rule quick-check for headers and add `curl` example to docs: 
```
curl -i https://api.redwood.ai/v2/generate \
  -H \"Accept: application/vnd.redwood-v2+json\" \
  -H \"X-RI-Compat: v1\" \
  -d '{\"prompt\":\"hi\"}'
```
Sam: Also add support in the query router to emit `deprecation_hint=true` span tag so distributed tracing surfaces it.
Jenny: I'll create the dashboard tiles and the prometheus rules. putting a draft in #monitoring this afternoon.
Ariane: ok next steps: Jenny build dashboard + alerts; Matt coordinate SDK header; Lee implement detection + mapping + circuit breaker; Sam run canary plan; I'll draft product banner copy and migrate plan.
deploy-bot: deployment started: `deprecation/detect-tag` to staging at 1829000300
dev-bot: perf test ran against v1-shim canary — p95 180ms, errors 0.6% (baseline), see https://perf.internal/r/abc
Ariane: thanks all — sync tomorrow 10am to decide go/no-go for beta rollout.
